flows.text:
sequenceDiagram
  participant n0 as Ordering
  participant n1 as Dispatch
  participant n2 as Fleet DB
  participant n3 as Notifications
  actor n4 as Courier
  participant n5 as Courier app
  participant n6 as Live tracking
  n0->>n1: Hears that an order was placed
  n1->>n2: Finds idle couriers near the restaurant
  Note over n1: Ranks them by how soon each could arrive
  n1->>n3: Sends the offer as a push
  n4->>n5: Accepts within 30 seconds
  n5->>n6: Streams its position every 5 seconds
  n6->>n0: The customer watches the courier come
  n5->>n0: Marks the order delivered

sequenceDiagram
  actor n0 as Customer
  participant n1 as Customer app
  participant n2 as Order API
  participant n3 as Stripe
  participant n4 as Orders DB
  participant n5 as Order events
  participant n6 as Delivery
  participant n7 as Kitchen tablet
  n0->>n1: Fills a basket and taps Place order
  n1->>n2: POST /orders with the basket
  n2->>n3: Holds the amount on the card
  n2->>n4: Saves the order as placed
  n2->>n5: Announces the order
  n5->>n6: Dispatch starts looking for a courier
  n2->>n7: The restaurant's tablet rings

sequenceDiagram
  actor n0 as Support agent
  participant n1 as Back office
  participant n2 as Ordering
  participant n3 as Stripe
  participant n4 as Notifications
  participant n5 as Twilio
  n0->>n1: Finds the order in the support console
  n1->>n2: Asks for a refund, in full or by line
  n2->>n3: The money goes back to the card
  n2->>n4: Asks for a confirmation to be sent
  n4->>n5: The customer gets an SMS
